name: What should be included in a room addition contract?

mainEntity.name: What should be included in a room addition contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: A comprehensive room addition contract should detail the full scope of work, including architectural plans, specifications for materials, and a clear payment schedule with milestones. It must outline project timelines, responsibilities of both parties, and provisions for change orders. Essential elements also include proof of the contractor's licensing and insurance, a dispute resolution process, and a warranty for workmanship. Always review the contract thoroughly and ensure all aspects of the project are clearly documented before signing.
acceptedAnswer.description: A room addition contract should cover the scope of work, materials, payment schedule, timelines, responsibilities, change order process, licensing, and warranty.
